definitions: The0.62 lane surfaced existing unresolved questions rather than creating a new measurement instrument. Reused unknowns remain unknown. Only10 activity questions were genuinely unasked. Two raw newly qualifying roles remain under separate review holds because the old role-specific inferences are too indirect. New inferred choices are transparent simulation assumptions, not observed student confirmation or independent fit validation.

One invitation snapshot; no adaptive re-questioning. Offer counts can include a shared activity question for more than one career. Unique model/question pairs are counted separately. All four cohorts retain the same global scoring rules.

source.label: Archived accumulated-answer diagnostics · not fresh-start coverage
definitions: Research only; live student matching and question flow unchanged.
Current extensive-answer results and fresh short-flow experiments are different conditions; do not conflate them.

Baseline short arm uses the conservative 0.90 question-scoped resolver, not the full historic answer executor. Repaired arms also restore existing explicit activity-option bindings; broad unreviewed career bindings are not activated.
Short experiment starts with saved lifestyle and official60 answers only; prior follow-ups are withheld. Twelve additional questions maximum.
Three short-flow arms isolate current simulator, whole-question answers/shared activity reuse, and three four-question targeting waves.
Unbound means no reviewed question-scoped binding was used; an older broader catalog construct may exist. Broad unreviewed occupational assumptions are not promoted to specific evidence.
Synthetic typed facts determine simulated answers; unknowns stay unknown. This is not real-student validation or proof of occupational fit.
Both cohorts informed development; fixed holdout splits are separately reported but are no longer unseen.
No use of demographics, mental health, lifestyle or desired education to grant interest evidence. No education score bonus.
Historical Top order and all support retained in the extensive replay. Short-flow careers are newly ranked; retention of extensive outcomes is not expected.
All remaining gap models receive a structured diagnostic audit; eight profile-level manual spot checks are included. Every proposed career has not been independently human-validated.

methods.code: scripts/build-performance-snapshot.mjs; filter cohort then count unique model IDs. Coverage = matching models / all models in scope. Never average cohort percentages.

source.label: Frozen Fieldguide evidence rules · full 1,000-model research benchmark
definitions: Research replay of frozen synthetic profiles; not observed student outcomes or validated accuracy. New Yes evidence is simulated and medium confidence.

Only four profession rules are tested. Of 172 authored profiles, only four have the previously frozen typed source annotations. The other authored interests remain unencoded, not absent. The 828 structured profiles can supply only scoped mathematics facts under these rules.
No new capture questions were administered; proposed questions are not validated scales. No 0.66 per-model answer lookup, text classifier, salary bonus, degree quota or lowered support threshold.

definitions: Research only. Six authored diagnostic items are not validated scales. Original 1,000 profiles retain unknown answers to these narrower new items.
Corrections remove invalid implications and can lower coverage. Raw profiles/transcripts remain unchanged; previous results retained.

Grok created whole-person synthetic profiles blind to occupations, rules and outcomes. Item text and structural schema were supplied. This tests a separate synthetic population, not actual student predictive validity.
The new holdout remains separate from development and all previous holdouts. No policies were retuned after its outcomes.

New holdout race marginal approximates US public-school enrollment; other whole-profile distributions are design choices and require coherence review. No claim of representative joint US demographics or diagnoses.

Comprehensive subject-aligned simulation is not typical student completion. Unprovided specialist preferences remain unknown. Qualitative strength and health/context text is inspectable, not parsed into match scores.
All education levels and existing earnings proxies retained. US holdout lifestyle comparisons use the same Austin reference budget/pay conventions, not regional cost estimates.

source.label: Scoped evidence corrections · paired 2,000-profile research replay
definitions: Research-only global scoped evidence corrections and seven closer inventory roles. Same rules in all 2000 cases. No new interests invented; unknown is not Yes. Post-holdout tuning: Grok cohort is no longer untouched validation. Preserve independent No/Unsure/holds. Negative contextual examples cannot veto unrelated career evidence. All new roles have null interest correlation pending a measured occupational vector; list after existing ranked supported careers, preserving existing Top ranks. Median pay is context only, never starting-pay lifestyle coverage.
New diagnostic probes are authored occupationally grounded drafts, not validated scales. Missing interests remain unknown.
Both cohorts are synthetic. Grok remains a separate cohort but its reviewed cases have now informed these corrections; this is post-holdout calibration, not independent validation.

source.label: Blind Grok versus existing response executor · fixed common current matcher
definitions: Same current 0.63 matcher, same catalog, same frozen profile and question exposure in both arms. This comparison deliberately excludes research 0.76 rule changes.

Exploration candidates use the unchanged production explorationRows059 selector, including visible contrary answers. Partial-specific follow-ups are a separate category. Fixed question exposure isolates the answer executor; it does not simulate adaptive new invitations. Lifestyle, profile context, strengths and training preferences remain frozen.

Supported alternatives are supported options outside Top three across the full catalog. Sustaining options are supported careers with an assessed pay proxy covering the same budget; these sets overlap Top and alternatives.
Higher Grok coverage is not proof of better matching. Unknown-to-Yes answers and answer-executor generosity can increase counts. Neither synthetic executor is student ground truth.

The original 172 authored profiles use narrative evidence; 828 procedural and 1000 Grok-authored profiles also supply explicit frozen activity facts. Evidence density differs and is reported separately.

Both executors receive the same questions per model, not the same number across models. No outcome-driven invitations or answer repair. Holdout groups remain separate; original and Grok synthetic populations are not pooled.
